config.stack_refill.title: Stack Refill
config.stack_refill.category.behavior.de: Choose when and how a used hotbar stack is replenished.
config.stack_refill.category.sources.des: Control which inventory stack is selected as the replacement.
Limit the situations and hotbar slots where refilling is allowed.
Allow or deny individual block item IDs.
config.stack_refill.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. You can also assign a toggle key in Minecraft's Controls menu.
config.stack_refill.threshold.tooltip: Refill after a successful block placement leaves this many items or fewer in the active stack.
config.stack_refill.refill_mode.tooltip: Replace swaps the source stack into the hotbar in one safe inventory action. Top Up combines exactly matching stacks and uses up to three actions.
config.stack_refill.delay.tooltip: Wait after the placement before moving a replacement stack.
config.stack_refill.cooldown.tooltip: Minimum delay between automatic inventory moves. Increase this for strict servers.
config.stack_refill.match_mode.tooltip: Exact requires the same item data, name, and components. Item Only can replace a stack with any variant of the same registered item. Top Up always uses exact matching.
config.stack_refill.source_strategy.tool: Determines which matching stack is chosen when several are available.
config.stack_refill.search_inventory.too: Use matching stacks from the 27 storage slots above the hotbar.
config.stack_refill.search_hotbar.toolti: Allow another hotbar slot to be used as a refill source.
config.stack_refill.minimum_source.toolt: Ignore matching source stacks smaller than this amount.
config.stack_refill.blocks_only.tooltip: Only react to items represented by Minecraft's BlockItem class. Disable this to refill any stack consumed by right-clicking a block.
config.stack_refill.pause_screens: Pause While a Screen Is Open
config.stack_refill.pause_screens.toolti: Delay pending refills while chat, inventory, or another screen is visible.
config.stack_refill.require_selected: Require the Original Slot to Stay Selected
config.stack_refill.require_selected.too: Cancel a delayed refill if you switch to a different hotbar slot first.
config.stack_refill.hotbar_slots.descrip: Choose which hotbar slots may be automatically refilled.
config.stack_refill.list_mode.tooltip: Blacklist refills everything except listed items. Whitelist refills only listed items.
config.stack_refill.item_rules.descripti: Enter registered IDs such as minecraft:stone. Modded block item IDs are supported.
config.stack_refill.notifications.toolti: Show a short action-bar message after an automatic refill.
config.stack_refill.notify_no_match: Notify When No Match Is Found
config.stack_refill.notify_no_match.tool: Tell you when a qualifying stack runs low but no configured refill source exists.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.stack_refill: Refills your current hotbar stack after placing blocks.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.stack_ref: A completely client-side hotbar stack refiller with configurable thresholds, matching, source priorities, delays, slot rules, and item allow/deny lists.
